notable_absence.finding: The response quotes error code 1050 and the page does not link to the error-code reference that documents it (server/current/n1ql/n1ql-language-reference/n1ql-error-codes.md, where 1050 is "No «parameter» value" with a stated user action). This absence is uniform across all four numeric-code example pages in the batch (1050 here, 3000 and 12003 on exn1qlerror.md, 1080 on extimeout.md) - not one of them links to the catalogue. See intro.json's cross_component_finding for the collective error-model record. Also absent: any statement of the HTTP status code returned. The example is run with curl -v, which would have shown it, but the response block starts at the JSON body, so the reader cannot tell that a request error returns HTTP 200 rather than 4xx - which is the surprising and important part.

version_finding: None. No version or edition marker. One detail worth recording for the error model rather than for versioning: this is the only error example whose metrics report "serviceLoad": 0 rather than 12, consistent with the request having been rejected before reaching the query engine.
